decisions.choice: "거짓 예언자" for the false prophet (19:20; 20:10); "더러운 영" (L, B), "악한 영" (R) for unclean spirits
decisions.reason: "예언자" is the style guide's word for prophet; the unclean spirits are worded as in the Korean Gospels (L, B "더러운 영", R "악한 영").
For the whole book (19:20; 20:10). The plain Portuguese words, at every level, as the title of the second beast (m2); "pseudoprofeta" is learned.
As the English Readable, which says "evil spirits"; Literal and Balanced keep the style guide's "अशुद्ध आत्मा".
As settled in Mark: "нечистый дух" at every level, Readable included.
"Жабы" is the word of the Egyptian plague (Exodus 8) in Russian, which the image recalls (m1).

decisions.choice: "лжепророк" for the false prophet at every level
decisions.reason: "Лжепророк" is the current Ukrainian word for a false prophet and a single word, as the Greek is; it is understood by new readers too.

source.text: εἰσὶν γὰρ πνεύματα δαιμονίων ποιοῦντα σημεῖα, ἃ ἐκπορεύεται ἐπὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς τῆς οἰκουμένης ὅλης, συναγαγεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν πόλεμον τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς μεγάλης τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ παντοκράτορος Ἰδοὺ ἔρχομαι ὡς κλέπτης.

records.literal_gloss: For they are spirits of demons doing signs, which go out to the kings of the inhabited world whole, to gather them into the war of the day the great of the God the Almighty. \v 15 Behold I am coming as a thief.

en.L: For they are spirits of demons performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole world, to gather them for the war of the great day of God the Almighty. \v 15 "Look, I am coming like a thief!
en.B: These are spirits of demons, doing signs, and they go out to the kings of all the world to assemble them for war on the great day of God, the Almighty. \v 15 "Look, I come like a thief!
en.R: They are spirits of demons that do miracles, called signs. They go out to the kings of the whole world. They gather the kings together for the battle on the great day of God, the Almighty. \v 15 "Listen! I will come when people do not expect me, like a thief.

fr.L: Car ce sont des esprits de démons qui font des signes, qui s’en vont vers les rois du monde habité tout entier, pour les rassembler pour la guerre du grand jour de Dieu, le Tout-Puissant. \v 15 « Voici, je viens comme un voleur !
fr.B: Ce sont des esprits de démons, qui font des signes ; ils vont trouver les rois du monde entier pour les rassembler en vue de la guerre du grand jour de Dieu, le Tout-Puissant. \v 15 « Voici, je viens comme un voleur !
fr.R: Ce sont des esprits de démons qui font des signes, des choses extraordinaires. Ils vont trouver les rois du monde entier. Ils rassemblent les rois pour la bataille du grand jour de Dieu, le Tout-Puissant. \v 15 « Écoutez ! Je viendrai au moment où l’on ne {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}attend pas, comme un voleur.

sw.L: Kwa maana hao ni roho wa mapepo wanaofanya ishara, wanaowaendea wafalme wa ulimwengu wote, ili kuwakusanya kwa ajili ya vita vya siku ile kuu ya Mungu Mwenyezi. \v 15 "Tazama, ninakuja kama mwizi!
sw.B: Hao ni roho wa pepo wanaofanya ishara, nao huwaendea wafalme wa dunia nzima ili kuwakusanya kwa ajili ya vita katika siku kuu ya Mungu, Mwenyezi. \v 15 "Tazama, ninakuja kama mwizi!
sw.R: Hao ni roho wa pepo wanaofanya miujiza inayoitwa ishara. Wanawaendea wafalme wa dunia nzima. Wanawakusanya wafalme hao kwa ajili ya vita katika siku ile kuu ya Mungu, Mwenyezi. \v 15 "Sikilizeni! Nitakuja wakati watu wasiponitarajia, kama mwizi.

es.L: Porque son espíritus de demonios que hacen señales, que salen hacia los reyes de todo el mundo habitado, para reunirlos para la guerra del gran día de Dios el Todopoderoso. \v 15 «Mira, vengo como un ladrón.
es.B: Son espíritus de demonios que hacen señales, y salen hacia los reyes de todo el mundo para reunirlos para la guerra del gran día de Dios, el Todopoderoso. \v 15 «¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}}, vengo como un ladrón!
es.R: Son espíritus de demonios que hacen milagros, llamados señales. Van a ver a los reyes de todo el mundo para reunirlos para la batalla del gran día de Dios, el Todopoderoso. \v 15 «¡{{plural_you:Escuchen|Escuchad}}! Vendré cuando nadie {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} espere, como viene un ladrón.

vi.L: Vì chúng là linh của các quỷ làm dấu lạ, đi đến các vua của cả thế gian, để tập hợp họ cho cuộc chiến trong ngày lớn của Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng. \v 15 "Kìa, Ta đến như kẻ trộm!
vi.B: Đó là những linh của các quỷ làm những dấu lạ, chúng đi đến các vua trên khắp thế gian để tập hợp họ lại cho cuộc chiến trong ngày lớn của Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng. \v 15 "Kìa, Ta đến như kẻ trộm!
vi.R: Chúng là những linh của các quỷ làm những phép lạ, gọi là dấu lạ. Chúng đi đến các vua trên khắp thế gian. Chúng tập hợp các vua lại để đánh trận trong ngày lớn của Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng. \v 15 "Hãy nghe đây! Ta sẽ đến khi người ta không ngờ, như kẻ trộm.

ko.L: 그것들은 표적을 행하는 귀신들의 영으로서, 온 세상의 왕들에게 가서, 전능하신 하나님의 큰 날의 전쟁을 위하여 그들을 모으려는 것이다. \v 15 "보라, 내가 도둑같이 온다!
ko.B: 그것들은 표적을 행하는 귀신들의 영이다. 그것들은 온 세상의 왕들에게 가서, 전능하신 하나님의 큰 날에 있을 전쟁을 위하여 그들을 모은다. \v 15 "보라, 내가 도둑같이 온다!
ko.R: 그것들은 표적이라고 부르는 놀라운 일들을 행하는 귀신들의 영이다. 그것들은 온 세상의 왕들에게 간다. 그것들은 전능하신 하나님의 큰 날에 있을 전쟁을 위하여 왕들을 모은다. \v 15 "잘 들어라! 사람들이 생각하지 못할 때에 내가 도둑같이 올 것이다.

pt.L: Pois são espíritos de demônios que fazem sinais, os quais saem aos reis do mundo inteiro, para reuni-los para a guerra do grande dia de Deus, o Todo-Poderoso. \v 15 "Eis que venho como ladrão!
pt.B: São espíritos de demônios que realizam sinais, e eles saem ao encontro dos reis do mundo inteiro para reuni-los para a guerra no grande dia de Deus, o Todo-Poderoso. \v 15 "Vejam: eu venho como um ladrão!
pt.R: Eles são espíritos de demônios que fazem milagres, chamados sinais. Eles vão até os reis do mundo inteiro e reúnem esses reis para a batalha no grande dia de Deus, o Todo-Poderoso. \v 15 "Escutem! Eu vou chegar quando ninguém estiver esperando, como um ladrão.

am.L: ተአምራትን የሚያደርጉ የአጋንንት መናፍስት ናቸውና፤ ለሁሉን ቻዩ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ቀን ጦርነት ይሰበስቧቸው ዘንድ ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ነገሥታት ይወጣሉ። \v 15 «እነሆ፣ እንደ ሌባ እመጣለሁ!
am.B: እነዚህ ተአምራትን የሚያደርጉ የአጋንንት መናፍስት ናቸው፤ ሁሉን ቻዩ እግዚአብሔር በታላቁ ቀኑ ለሚያደርገው ጦርነት ሊሰበስቧቸው ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ነገሥታት ይወጣሉ። \v 15 «አስተውሉ፤ እንደ ሌባ እመጣለሁ!
am.R: እነርሱ ተአምራትን የሚያደርጉ የአጋንንት መናፍስት ናቸው። ወደ ዓለም ሁሉ ነገሥታት ይሄዳሉ። ሁሉን ቻዩ እግዚአብሔር በታላቁ ቀኑ ለሚያደርገው ጦርነት ነገሥታቱን ይሰበስባሉ። \v 15 «ስሙ! ሰዎች ባልጠበቁኝ ጊዜ እንደ ሌባ እመጣለሁ።

hi.L: क्योंकि ये चिह्न दिखानेवाली दुष्टात्माओं की आत्माएँ हैं, जो सारे संसार के राजाओं के पास निकलकर जाती हैं, कि उन्हें सर्वशक्तिमान परमेश्वर के उस बड़े दिन के युद्ध के लिए इकट्ठा करें। \v 15 "देखो, मैं चोर के समान आता हूँ!
hi.B: ये दुष्टात्माओं की आत्माएँ हैं जो चिह्न दिखाती हैं, और ये सारे संसार के राजाओं के पास जाती हैं, ताकि उन्हें सर्वशक्तिमान परमेश्वर के बड़े दिन के युद्ध के लिए इकट्ठा करें। \v 15 "देखो, मैं चोर की तरह आता हूँ!
hi.R: ये दुष्टात्माओं की आत्माएँ हैं जो चमत्कार करती हैं, जिन्हें चिह्न कहा जाता है। वे सारी दुनिया के राजाओं के पास जाती हैं। वे उन राजाओं को सर्वशक्तिमान परमेश्वर के बड़े दिन की लड़ाई के लिए इकट्ठा करती हैं। \v 15 "सुनो! मैं ऐसे समय आऊँगा जब लोग मेरी आशा न करते होंगे, जैसे चोर आता है।

ru.L: Ведь это духи бесов, творящие знамения, которые выходят к царям всей вселенной, чтобы собрать их на войну великого дня Бога Вседержителя. \v 15 «Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} иду, как вор!
ru.B: Это духи бесов, совершающие знамения; они выходят к царям всего мира, чтобы собрать их на войну в великий день Бога Вседержителя. \v 15 «Вот, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} прихожу, как вор!
ru.R: Это духи бесов, которые делают чудеса — знаки. Они выходят к царям всего мира. Они собирают царей для битвы в великий день Бога Вседержителя. \v 15 «Слушайте! Я приду, когда люди не будут {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} ждать, как приходит вор.

uk.L: Бо це духи бісів, що чинять знаки, які виходять до царів усього всесвіту, щоб зібрати їх на війну великого дня Бога Вседержителя. \v 15 «Ось {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приходжу, як злодій!
uk.B: Це духи бісів, що чинять знаки, і вони виходять до царів усього світу, щоб зібрати їх на війну у великий день Бога Вседержителя. \v 15 «Дивись, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} приходжу, як злодій!
uk.R: Це духи бісів, які роблять чудеса, що звуться знаками. Вони йдуть до царів усього світу. Вони збирають царів разом на битву у великий день Бога Вседержителя. \v 15 «Слухайте! Я прийду тоді, коли люди {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} не чекають, як злодій.

ja.L: これらは、しるしを行う悪霊どもの霊であって、全世界の王たちのところへ出て行き、全能者である神の大いなる日の戦いのために、彼らを集めるのである。\v 15 「見よ、わたしは盗人のように来る。
ja.B: これらはしるしを行う悪霊の霊であり、全世界の王たちのもとへ出て行って、全能者である神の大いなる日の戦いのために、彼らを集める。\v 15 「見よ、わたしは盗人のように来る。
ja.R: これらは悪霊の霊で、しるしと呼ばれる不思議なわざを行います。それらは全世界の王たちのところへ出て行き、すべてを治める方である神の大いなる日の戦いのために、王たちを集めます。\v 15 「よく聞きなさい。わたしは、人々が思いもしない時に、どろぼうのように来る。

decisions.choice: Christ's words break into the vision
decisions.reason: The words "Look, I am coming like a thief" and the blessing that follows (16:15) are spoken by Christ himself, breaking into John's account as a warning to the readers. The SBLGNT sets them apart from the narrative. In the source data the sentence divisions fall so that 16:15 is split across this record and the next; the record follows those divisions.

decisions.choice: the war of the great day of God
decisions.reason: This is the final battle, described in 19:11-21 and 20:7-10. "The great day" recalls "the great day of their wrath" (6:17) and the prophets' day of the LORD.
See the note on 3:3.
As in 13:13.

alternatives: des miracles, qu’on appelle des signes
decisions.reason: As in 13:13: the term sheet never uses "miracle" for sign, so Readable keeps "signes" and says what they were.

alternatives: m’attend with no span, as the English "me"
decisions.reason: Christ speaks of himself; the French style guide (§7) puts the deity_pronoun span on "me", "m’" in his words, though the English "me" has none. "Je" takes no span.

Christ's words break into the vision and are spoken to all readers, so Balanced and Readable use the plural, as "idou" said to a group is rendered in 1:7; Literal keeps the bare "Mira" of the Greek form.

decisions.choice: "Ta" for Christ breaking in at 16:15, as in 3:3
decisions.reason: Christ's own words break into the vision (m1), with the "like a thief" of 3:3, so he says "Ta", which takes no span at the start of the sentence.

decisions.choice: Christ's words breaking into the vision in his 해라체, "내가 도둑같이 온다", with "오다" as in 3:11
decisions.reason: The meaning decision marks these as Christ's own words set into the vision; Korean gives them his style and the wording of 3:3 ("도둑같이"), with "오다" for his final coming (see 3:3).
The Greek keeps both words, and Amharic can too; the spirits of 16:13 are named again as demonic, so the phrase stays at every level.
As in 13:13.
Christ speaks; Russian "я" and "меня" for him take the deity_pronoun span (style guide, 7b), where the English "I" and "me" have none.

decisions.choice: Christ's words in the plain style: "見よ" (L, B), "よく聞きなさい" (R); "盗人" (L, B), "どろぼう" (R)
decisions.reason: Christ breaks into the account to warn the readers (m1) and speaks plainly with authority, as in the letters of chapters 2-3. "Look" takes the book's "見よ" in Christ's speech (1:7; 3:20); the word for thief follows John's "盗人" / "どろぼう".

source.text: μακάριος ὁ γρηγορῶν καὶ τηρῶν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ, ἵνα μὴ γυμνὸς περιπατῇ καὶ βλέπωσιν τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτοῦ καὶ συνήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν τόπον τὸν καλούμενον Ἑβραϊστὶ Ἁρμαγεδών.

records.literal_gloss: Blessed the [one] watching and keeping the garments of him, so that not naked he walks and they see the shame of him. \v 16 And he gathered them into the place the [one] being called in Hebrew Armageddon.

en.L: Blessed [is] the one who stays awake and keeps {{gender:their|his}} garments, so that {{gender:they may|he may}} not walk naked and people see {{gender:their|his}} shame." \v 16 And [the spirits] gathered them to the place that is called in Hebrew Armageddon.
en.B: How blessed is anyone who keeps watch and holds on to {{gender:their|his}} clothes, and so will not walk about naked with {{gender:their|his}} shame on view!" \v 16 And the spirits brought the kings together at the place called in Hebrew Armageddon.
en.R: God blesses the person who stays awake and keeps {{gender:their|his}} clothes on. Then {{gender:they|he}} will not have to walk around naked and be ashamed." \v 16 Then the spirits gathered the kings together at the place called Armageddon in the Hebrew language.

fr.L: Heureux celui qui veille et qui garde ses vêtements, afin de ne pas marcher nu et qu’on ne voie pas sa honte. » \v 16 Et [les esprits] les rassemblèrent au lieu appelé en hébreu Harmaguédon.
fr.B: Heureux celui qui veille et qui garde ses vêtements, pour ne pas aller nu en laissant voir sa honte ! » \v 16 Et les esprits rassemblèrent les rois au lieu appelé en hébreu Harmaguédon.
fr.R: Dieu bénit celui qui reste éveillé et garde ses vêtements sur lui. Il n’aura pas à se promener tout nu et à avoir honte. » \v 16 Puis les esprits ont rassemblé les rois à l’endroit qu’on appelle Harmaguédon en hébreu.

sw.L: Heri aliye macho na kuyatunza mavazi yake, ili asitembee uchi na watu wakaiona aibu yake." \v 16 Na [pepo hao] wakawakusanya mahali paitwapo kwa Kiebrania Armagedoni.
sw.B: Heri mtu anayekesha na kuyashika mavazi yake, ili asitembee uchi, aibu yake ikaonekana!" \v 16 Kisha pepo hao wakawakusanya wafalme mahali paitwapo kwa Kiebrania Armagedoni.
sw.R: Mungu humbariki mtu anayekaa macho na kuvaa mavazi yake. Hatatembea uchi na kuona aibu." \v 16 Kisha pepo hao wakawakusanya wafalme mahali paitwapo Armagedoni kwa lugha ya Kiebrania.

es.L: Dichoso el que vela y guarda su ropa, para que no ande desnudo y vean su vergüenza». \v 16 Y [los espíritus] los reunieron en el lugar que en hebreo se llama Armagedón.
es.B: ¡Qué dichoso es el que se mantiene despierto y guarda su ropa, para no andar desnudo y que todos vean su vergüenza!». \v 16 Y los espíritus reunieron a los reyes en el lugar que en hebreo se llama Armagedón.
es.R: Dios bendice al que se mantiene despierto y tiene su ropa puesta. Así no tendrá que andar desnudo ni pasar vergüenza». \v 16 Luego los espíritus reunieron a los reyes en el lugar que en el idioma hebreo se llama Armagedón.

vi.L: Phước cho người tỉnh thức và giữ áo xống mình, để khỏi phải đi trần truồng và người ta thấy sự xấu hổ của mình." \v 16 Và [các linh ấy] tập hợp họ lại tại nơi theo tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ gọi là Ha-ma-ghê-đôn.
vi.B: Phước thay cho người tỉnh thức và giữ lấy áo xống mình, để khỏi phải đi lại trần truồng, phơi bày sự xấu hổ của mình!" \v 16 Rồi các linh ấy tập hợp các vua lại tại nơi theo tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ gọi là Ha-ma-ghê-đôn.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời ban phước cho người tỉnh thức và mặc áo đàng hoàng. Như vậy người ấy sẽ không phải đi trần truồng và bị xấu hổ." \v 16 Rồi các linh ấy tập hợp các vua lại tại nơi theo tiếng Hê-bơ-rơ gọi là Ha-ma-ghê-đôn.

ko.L: 깨어 있어 자기 옷을 지키는 사람은 복이 있다. 그는 벌거벗고 다니지 않고, 사람들이 그의 부끄러운 곳을 보지 않을 것이다." \v 16 그리고 [영들이] 히브리 말로 아마겟돈이라고 하는 곳으로 왕들을 모았다.
ko.B: 깨어 있어 자기 옷을 지키는 사람은 복이 있다! 그는 벌거벗은 채 다니며 수치를 드러내지 않을 것이다." \v 16 그 영들은 히브리 말로 아마겟돈이라고 하는 곳으로 왕들을 모았다.
ko.R: 깨어 있어서 옷을 입고 있는 사람에게 하나님께서 복을 주신다. 그 사람은 벌거벗고 다니며 부끄러움을 당하지 않을 것이다." \v 16 그때 그 영들은 히브리 말로 아마겟돈이라고 하는 곳에 왕들을 모았다.

pt.L: Bem-aventurado o que vigia e guarda as suas roupas, para que não ande nu e não vejam a sua vergonha." \v 16 E [os espíritos] os reuniram no lugar que em hebraico se chama Armagedom.
pt.B: Bem-aventurado quem fica vigiando e guarda as suas roupas, para não andar nu, com a sua vergonha à vista de todos!" \v 16 E os espíritos reuniram os reis no lugar que em hebraico se chama Armagedom.

am.L: ራቁቱን እንዳይሄድ፣ [ሰዎችም] ኀፍረቱን እንዳያዩ የሚተጋና ልብሱን የሚጠብቅ የተባረከ ነው።» \v 16 [መናፍስቱም] በዕብራይስጥ አርማጌዶን ወደሚባለው ስፍራ ሰበሰቧቸው።

decisions.choice: the third blessing: staying awake and clothed
decisions.reason: This is the third of the book's seven blessings (1:3). Staying awake and keeping one's clothes means remaining faithful and ready (3:2-4, 18). To be found naked is to be put to shame at his coming.

alternatives: a real place where the final battle will be fought
a symbol of the final gathering of the nations against God
decisions.reason: The name is most likely Hebrew "Har Megiddo", "mountain of Megiddo". Megiddo overlooked a plain where famous battles were fought (Judges 5:19; 2 Kings 23:29; compare Zechariah 12:11), but there is no mountain of that name. The name may be a symbol for the place where the nations gather against God and are defeated.

decisions.choice: he gathered: the spirits are the subject
decisions.reason: συνήγαγεν is singular, but its subject is most likely the spirits of 16:13-14; a neuter plural subject in Greek can take a singular verb.
Balanced and Readable name the subject and the object (m3).

decisions.choice: "celui qui … ses vêtements … sa honte", "il" with no gender span
alternatives: "la personne … elle" with a gender span
decisions.reason: Where the English needs {{gender:their|his}} and {{gender:they|he}}, French "celui qui" is generic and its possessives say nothing about sex, so the French style guide (§7) adds no span.
"Harmaguédon" is the usual French spelling of the name and keeps its first syllable, "mountain" (m2); "Armageddon" is the English form.
The place name in its familiar Swahili form; the meaning decision explains that it is the mountain of Megiddo (m2).

alternatives: a gender span, as in the English
decisions.reason: The Swahili possessive "yake" means his or her and the verb prefix "a-" he or she, so the English spans "their|his" have no Swahili counterpart.

decisions.choice: el que vela ... desnudo (no gender span)
decisions.reason: Spanish "el que" and "desnudo" are the generic forms and include women, as in 3:5 and 14:9, so the English gender span on "their/his" has no Spanish counterpart.
The usual Spanish spelling of the name; the meaning decision explains that it points to the hill of Megiddo.

decisions.choice: "Ha-ma-ghê-đôn" for Armageddon; "người", "mình" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Armageddon is the mountain of Megiddo (m2); Vietnamese gives the name in the hyphenated form Vietnamese Protestant readers know. "Người" and "mình" include everyone, so the English their/his setting has nothing to change. The blessing keeps the form of 1:3.

decisions.choice: "아마겟돈" in its Protestant form; no gender spans for "his"
decisions.reason: The name is given in Hangul as Korean readers know it; the meaning decision explains it as the mountain of Megiddo (uncertain, footnoted). Korean "그" and "자기" need no gender setting.

decisions.choice: o que vigia ... as suas roupas ... nu (L, B); a pessoa ... ela (R), with no gender setting
decisions.reason: As in 2:7: "o que" and "quem" are generic in Portuguese and include women, and "suas" has no gender, so the English gender spans have nothing to fall on; Readable says "a pessoa ... ela", as the English Readable says "they".

For the whole book. The name in its established Portuguese spelling, which readers know; "Harmagedom" is closer to the Hebrew "mountain of Megiddo" (m2) but unfamiliar, and the meaning note explains the name.

alternatives: a singular verb, as the Greek
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is singular because its subject, the spirits, is a neuter plural; an Amharic singular would point to Christ, who has just spoken, so the verb is plural and Literal brackets the subject.
Hindi "वह" and "व्यक्ति" already include everyone, so the setting has nothing to change.
The established Hindi Bible form of the name.
The Beatitude form as settled in Matthew (14:13).

Japanese needs the subject the singular Greek verb leaves to the context, the spirits of 16:13-14 (m3); Literal brackets it, and writes "王たち" for the Greek "them" so that the sentence is not read as the spirits gathering themselves.

source.text: Καὶ ὁ ἕβδομος ἐξέχεεν τὴν φιάλην αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ἀέρα καὶ ἐξῆλθεν φωνὴ μεγάλη ἐκ τοῦ ναοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θρόνου λέγουσα· Γέγονεν καὶ ἐγένοντο ἀστραπαὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ βρονταί, καὶ σεισμὸς ἐγένετο μέγας, οἷος οὐκ ἐγένετο ἀφ’ οὗ ἄνθρωποι ἐγένοντο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τηλικοῦτος σεισμὸς οὕτω μέγας, καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη εἰς τρία μέρη, καὶ αἱ πόλεις τῶν ἐθνῶν ἔπεσαν· καὶ Βαβυλὼν ἡ μεγάλη ἐμνήσθη ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ δοῦναι αὐτῇ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ οἴνου τοῦ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: And the seventh poured out the bowl of him on the air, and came out a voice great out of the temple from the throne saying: It has happened. \v 18 And there were lightnings and voices and thunders, and earthquake happened great, such as not happened since men came to be on the earth, so great earthquake so mighty, \v 19 and became the city the great into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell; and Babylon the great was remembered before the God to give her the cup of the wine of the fury of the wrath of him;

en.L: And the seventh poured out his bowl on the air, and a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne, saying, "It is done!" \v 18 And there were lightnings and voices and thunders, and there was a great earthquake, such as had not happened since {{gender:people|men}} came to be on the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty, \v 19 and the great city split into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell, and Babylon the great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the fury of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wrath.
en.B: When the seventh angel emptied his bowl into the air, a great voice came out of the temple, from the throne: "It is done!" \v 18 Lightning, loud sounds, and thunder followed, and an earthquake struck so violent that nothing like it had ever happened since human beings first lived on the earth. \v 19 The great city was torn into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was not forgotten before God: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made her drink the cup of the wine of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} raging anger.
en.R: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came from the throne in the temple. It said, "It is finished!" \v 18 There was lightning, loud noise, and thunder. And there was a terrible earthquake, the worst since people have lived on the earth. \v 19 The great city split into three parts. The cities of the nations fell down. And God remembered Babylon the great city. He made her drink from the cup filled with the wine of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} terrible anger.

fr.L: Et le septième versa sa coupe dans l’air, et une voix forte sortit du temple, du trône, disant : « C’est fait ! » \v 18 Et il y eut des éclairs, et des voix, et des tonnerres, et il y eut un grand tremblement de terre, tel qu’il n’y en avait pas eu depuis que les {{gender:humains|hommes}} sont sur la terre, un tremblement de terre si grand, si violent, \v 19 et la grande ville se divisa en trois parties, et les villes des nations tombèrent, et Babylone la grande fut rappelée au souvenir devant Dieu, pour lui donner la coupe du vin de la fureur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.B: Quand le septième ange vida sa coupe dans l’air, une voix forte sortit du temple, venant du trône : « C’est fait ! » \v 18 Il y eut des éclairs, des fracas et des coups de tonnerre, et un tremblement de terre si violent qu’il n’y en avait jamais eu de pareil depuis que les êtres humains vivent sur la terre. \v 19 La grande ville se fendit en trois parties, et les villes des nations s’écroulèrent. Dieu n’oublia pas Babylone la grande : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} lui fit boire la coupe du vin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ardente.
fr.R: Le septième ange a versé sa coupe dans l’air. Une voix forte est venue du trône, dans le temple. Elle a dit : « C’est fini ! » \v 18 Il y a eu des éclairs, de grands bruits et du tonnerre. Et il y a eu un terrible tremblement de terre, le pire depuis que les gens vivent sur la terre. \v 19 La grande ville s’est fendue en trois parties. Les villes des nations se sont écroulées. Et Dieu s’est souvenu de Babylone la grande ville. Il lui a fait boire la coupe remplie du vin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terrible colère.

sw.L: Na wa saba akalimimina bakuli lake juu ya anga, na sauti kubwa ikatoka katika hekalu, kutoka kwenye kiti cha enzi, ikisema, "Imekwisha kuwa!" \v 18 Na kukawa na umeme wa radi na sauti na ngurumo, na kukawa na tetemeko kuu la nchi, ambalo halijawahi kutokea tangu wanadamu walipokuwa juu ya dunia, tetemeko kubwa namna hiyo, kuu hivyo, \v 19 na mji ule mkubwa ukagawanyika sehemu tatu, na miji ya mataifa ikaanguka, na Babeli mkuu akakumbukwa mbele za Mungu, ili ampe kikombe cha divai ya hasira kali ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Malaika wa saba alipolimwaga bakuli lake angani, sauti kubwa ikatoka hekaluni, kutoka kwenye kiti cha enzi, ikisema: "Imekwisha!" \v 18 Kukawa na umeme wa radi, sauti kubwa na ngurumo, na tetemeko la nchi likatokea, kubwa mno kiasi kwamba halijawahi kutokea kama hilo tangu wanadamu walipoanza kuishi duniani. \v 19 Mji ule mkubwa ukapasuka sehemu tatu, na miji ya mataifa ikaanguka. Mungu hakumsahau Babeli mkuu: alimnywesha kikombe cha divai ya hasira kali ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Malaika wa saba alilimimina bakuli lake angani. Sauti kubwa ikatoka kwenye kiti cha enzi kilichokuwa hekaluni. Ilisema, "Yote yamekamilika!" \v 18 Kukawa na umeme wa radi, kelele kubwa na ngurumo. Kukawa pia na tetemeko kubwa la nchi, baya kuliko yote tangu wanadamu waanze kuishi duniani. \v 19 Mji ule mkubwa ukagawanyika sehemu tatu. Miji ya mataifa ikaanguka. Mungu akaukumbuka Babeli, ule mji mkubwa. Alimnywesha kikombe kilichojaa divai ya hasira kali ya ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: Y el séptimo derramó su copa sobre el aire, y salió una gran voz del templo, desde el trono, que decía: «Hecho está». \v 18 Y hubo relámpagos y voces y truenos, y hubo un gran terremoto, como no lo hubo desde que {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}} existen sobre la tierra, un terremoto tan grande, tan fuerte, \v 19 y la gran ciudad se partió en tres partes, y las ciudades de las naciones cayeron, y Babilonia la grande fue recordada delante de Dios, para darle la copa del vino del furor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.B: Cuando el séptimo ángel derramó su copa en el aire, del templo salió una gran voz que venía del trono: «¡Ya está hecho!». \v 18 Hubo relámpagos, estruendos y truenos, y un terremoto tan violento como no lo había habido jamás desde que hay seres humanos sobre la tierra. \v 19 La gran ciudad se partió en tres partes, y las ciudades de las naciones se derrumbaron. Dios no se olvidó de Babilonia la grande: le dio a beber la copa del vino de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ardiente ira.
es.R: El séptimo ángel derramó su copa en el aire. Del trono que está en el templo salió una voz fuerte que dijo: «¡Todo ha terminado!». \v 18 Hubo relámpagos, ruidos fuertes y truenos. Y hubo un terremoto terrible, el peor desde que hay gente en la tierra. \v 19 La gran ciudad se partió en tres partes. Las ciudades de las naciones se derrumbaron. Y Dios se acordó de Babilonia la gran ciudad. La hizo beber de la copa llena del vino de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} terrible ira.

vi.L: Và vị thứ bảy đổ bát của mình vào không trung, thì có một tiếng lớn từ đền thờ, từ ngai, nói: "Xong rồi!" \v 18 Và có những tia chớp, những tiếng động, những tiếng sấm, và một trận động đất lớn xảy ra, lớn đến nỗi từ khi có loài người trên đất chưa từng có trận động đất nào lớn như vậy, mạnh như vậy, \v 19 và thành lớn bị chia làm ba phần, và các thành của các dân tộc sụp đổ, và Đức Chúa Trời nhớ đến Ba-by-lôn lớn, để cho nó uống chén rượu của cơn giận dữ của thịnh nộ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Khi thiên sứ thứ bảy đổ bát của mình vào không trung, có một tiếng lớn từ đền thờ, từ nơi ngai, phán: "Xong rồi!" \v 18 Chớp nhoáng, có những tiếng động lớn và tiếng sấm, và một trận động đất dữ dội xảy ra, đến nỗi từ khi có loài người trên đất chưa từng có trận động đất nào như vậy. \v 19 Thành lớn bị chia làm ba phần, và các thành của các dân tộc sụp đổ. Đức Chúa Trời không quên Ba-by-lôn lớn: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bắt nó uống chén rượu của cơn thịnh nộ dữ dội của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Thiên sứ thứ bảy đổ bát của mình vào không trung. Một tiếng lớn từ ngai trong đền thờ phán: "Xong rồi!" \v 18 Có chớp nhoáng, tiếng động lớn và sấm sét. Và có một trận động đất khủng khiếp, mạnh nhất kể từ khi có loài người sống trên đất. \v 19 Thành lớn bị chia làm ba phần. Các thành của các dân tộc đều sụp đổ. Và Đức Chúa Trời nhớ đến thành lớn Ba-by-lôn. Ngài bắt nó uống chén đầy rượu của cơn giận khủng khiếp của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 일곱째 [천사]가 자기 대접을 공중에 쏟았다. 그러자 성전에서, 보좌로부터 큰 음성이 나서 말하였다. "이루어졌다!" \v 18 그리고 번개와 음성과 천둥이 있었고, 큰 지진이 일어났다. 그것은 사람이 땅 위에 생긴 뒤로 일어난 적이 없는 큰 지진, 그토록 강한 지진이었다. \v 19 그리고 큰 도시가 세 조각으로 갈라졌고, 민족들의 도시들도 무너졌다. 그리고 하나님께서 큰 바빌론을 기억하셔서, 그분의 진노의 분노의 포도주 잔을 그 도시에게 주셨다.
ko.B: 일곱째 천사가 자기 대접을 공중에 쏟자, 성전 안 보좌에서 큰 음성이 나서 말했다. "이루어졌다!" \v 18 그러자 번개와 요란한 소리와 천둥이 일어났고, 큰 지진이 일어났다. 그 지진은 사람이 땅 위에 살기 시작한 뒤로 한 번도 없었던, 그토록 강한 지진이었다. \v 19 큰 도시가 세 조각으로 갈라졌고, 민족들의 도시들도 무너졌다. 하나님께서는 큰 바빌론을 잊지 않으시고, 그분의 맹렬한 진노의 포도주 잔을 그 도시에게 마시게 하셨다.
ko.R: 일곱째 천사가 자기 대접을 공중에 쏟았다. 그러자 성전 안에 있는 보좌에서 큰 음성이 들려왔다. "다 끝났다!" \v 18 번개가 치고, 큰 소리와 천둥이 울렸다. 그리고 무서운 지진이 일어났다. 그것은 사람들이 땅에 살기 시작한 뒤로 가장 무서운 지진이었다. \v 19 큰 도시가 세 조각으로 갈라졌다. 민족들의 도시들도 무너졌다. 그리고 하나님께서는 큰 도시 바빌론을 기억하셨다. 하나님께서는 그분의 무서운 진노로 가득 찬 포도주 잔을 그 도시에게 마시게 하셨다.

pt.L: E o sétimo derramou a sua taça sobre o ar, e saiu uma grande voz do templo, do trono, dizendo: "Está feito!" \v 18 E houve relâmpagos, e vozes, e trovões, e houve um grande terremoto, como nunca houve desde que {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} existem sobre a terra, um terremoto tão grande, tão forte, \v 19 e a grande cidade se dividiu em três partes, e as cidades das nações caíram, e Babilônia, a grande, foi lembrada diante de Deus, para lhe dar o cálice do vinho da fúria da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira.
pt.B: Quando o sétimo anjo esvaziou a sua taça no ar, uma grande voz saiu do templo, do trono: "Está feito!" \v 18 Vieram relâmpagos, estrondos e trovões, e houve um terremoto tão violento que nada igual tinha acontecido desde que o ser humano começou a viver na terra. \v 19 A grande cidade foi partida em três, e as cidades das nações caíram. Deus não se esqueceu de Babilônia, a grande: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a fez beber o cálice do vinho da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira furiosa.
pt.R: O sétimo anjo derramou a sua taça no ar. Uma voz forte veio do trono que está no templo. Ela disse: "Tudo terminou!" \v 18 Houve relâmpagos, barulhos fortes e trovões. E houve um terremoto terrível, o pior desde que existem pessoas na terra. \v 19 A grande cidade se partiu em três partes. As cidades das nações caíram. E Deus se lembrou de Babilônia, a grande cidade. Ele a fez beber do cálice cheio do vinho da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira terrível.

am.L: ሰባተኛውም ጽዋውን በአየር ላይ አፈሰሰ፤ ከቤተ መቅደሱም ከዙፋኑ፦ «ተደርጓል!» የሚል ታላቅ ድምፅ ወጣ። \v 18 መብረቆችና ድምፆች ነጎድጓዶችም ሆኑ፤ ሰዎች በምድር ላይ ከሆኑ ጀምሮ እንደ እርሱ ያልሆነ ታላቅ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ፤ እንዲህ ያለ ብርቱ፣ እንዲህ ያለ ታላቅ የምድር መናወጥ። \v 19 ታላቂቱም ከተማ ሦስት ክፍል ሆነች፤ የአሕዛብም ከተሞች ወደቁ፤ ታላቂቱም ባቢሎን የመዓቱን ቁጣ ወይን ጠጅ ዋንጫ እንዲሰጣት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ታሰበች።
am.B: ሰባተኛው መልአክ ጽዋውን በአየር ላይ አፈሰሰ፤ ከቤተ መቅደሱም ከዙፋኑ ታላቅ ድምፅ እንዲህ ሲል ወጣ፦ «ተፈጸመ!» \v 18 መብረቅ፣ ድምፅና ነጎድጓድ ሆነ፤ የሰው ዘር በምድር ላይ መኖር ከጀመረ ወዲህ ታይቶ የማያውቅ እጅግ ብርቱ የምድር መናወጥም ሆነ። \v 19 ታላቂቱ ከተማ ለሦስት ተከፈለች፤ የአሕዛብም ከተሞች ወደቁ። ታላቂቱ ባቢሎንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አልተረሳችም፤ የመዓቱን ብርቱ ቁጣ ወይን ጠጅ ዋንጫ አጠጣት።
am.R: ሰባተኛው መልአክ ጽዋውን በአየር ላይ አፈሰሰ። በቤተ መቅደሱ ካለው ዙፋን ታላቅ ድምፅ ወጣ። እንዲህም አለ፦ «አበቃ!» \v 18 መብረቅ፣ ታላቅ ድምፅና ነጎድጓድ ሆነ። ከዚያም ሰዎች በምድር ላይ መኖር ከጀመሩ ወዲህ ታይቶ የማያውቅ እጅግ አስከፊ የምድር መናወጥ ሆነ። \v 19 ታላቂቱ ከተማ ለሦስት ተከፈለች። የሕዝቦች ከተሞችም ፈራረሱ። እግዚአብሔርም ታላቂቱን ከተማ ባቢሎንን አሰባት። የአስከፊ ቁጣውን ወይን ጠጅ በተሞላ ዋንጫ አጠጣት።

hi.L: और सातवें ने अपना कटोरा हवा पर उँडेल दिया, और मन्दिर में से, सिंहासन की ओर से, एक ऊँचा शब्द यह कहता हुआ निकला, "हो चुका!" \v 18 और बिजलियाँ और शब्द और गर्जन हुए, और एक ऐसा बड़ा भूकंप हुआ जैसा मनुष्यों के पृथ्वी पर होने के समय से कभी न हुआ था, इतना बड़ा भूकंप, इतना प्रचंड, \v 19 और वह बड़ी नगरी तीन टुकड़े हो गई, और जातियों के नगर गिर पड़े, और परमेश्वर के सामने बड़ी बाबुल का स्मरण हुआ, कि वे उसे अपने प्रकोप के क्रोध के दाखरस का कटोरा पिलाएँ।
hi.B: जब सातवें स्वर्गदूत ने अपना कटोरा हवा में उँडेला, तो मन्दिर में से, सिंहासन की ओर से, एक ऊँची आवाज़ आई: "हो चुका!" \v 18 फिर बिजलियाँ चमकीं, आवाज़ें हुईं और बादल गरजे, और ऐसा भयंकर भूकंप आया कि जब से मनुष्य पृथ्वी पर हुए, तब से ऐसा कभी नहीं हुआ था। \v 19 वह बड़ी नगरी फटकर तीन भाग हो गई, और जातियों के नगर ढह गए। परमेश्वर ने बड़ी बाबुल को भुलाया नहीं: उन्होंने उसे अपने भड़के हुए क्रोध के दाखरस का प्याला पिलाया।
hi.R: सातवें स्वर्गदूत ने अपना कटोरा हवा में उँडेल दिया। मन्दिर में सिंहासन की ओर से एक ऊँची आवाज़ आई। उसने कहा, "पूरा हो गया!" \v 18 बिजली चमकी, ज़ोर का शोर हुआ और बादल गरजे। और एक भयानक भूकंप आया। जब से लोग पृथ्वी पर रहने लगे, तब से इतना बुरा भूकंप कभी नहीं आया था। \v 19 वह बड़ी नगरी फटकर तीन हिस्सों में बँट गई। देशों के नगर गिर पड़े। परमेश्वर ने बड़ी नगरी बाबुल को याद किया। उन्होंने उसे अपने भयानक क्रोध के दाखरस से भरे प्याले में से पिलाया।

ru.L: И седьмой вылил чашу свою на воздух, и вышел громкий голос из храма от престола, говорящий: «Свершилось!» \v 18 И были молнии, и голоса, и громы, и произошло великое землетрясение, какого не бывало с тех пор, как люди появились на земле, — такое землетрясение, такое сильное; \v 19 и великий город распался на три части, и города народов пали, и Вавилон великий был вспомянут перед Богом, чтобы дать ему чашу вина ярости гнева {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Когда седьмой ангел излил свою чашу в воздух, из храма, от престола, раздался громкий голос: «Свершилось!» \v 18 Последовали молнии, раскаты и громы, и произошло такое сильное землетрясение, какого не бывало с тех пор, как на земле появились люди. \v 19 Великий город раскололся на три части, и города народов пали. Бог не забыл и Вавилон великий: {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} заставил его выпить чашу вина своей неистовой ярости.
ru.R: Седьмой ангел вылил свою чашу в воздух. Из храма, от престола, раздался громкий голос: «Всё кончено!» \v 18 Засверкали молнии, раздался грохот и гром. И случилось страшное землетрясение, самое сильное с тех пор, как на земле живут люди. \v 19 Великий город раскололся на три части. Города народов рухнули. И Бог вспомнил о великом городе Вавилоне. Он заставил его выпить чашу, полную вина своего страшного гнева.

uk.L: І сьомий вилив свою чашу на повітря, і вийшов гучний голос із храму, від престолу, що казав: «Сталося!» \v 18 І настали блискавки, і голоси, і громи, і стався великий землетрус, якого не бувало, відколи люди зʼявилися на землі, такий землетрус, такий великий, \v 19 і велике місто розкололося на три частини, і міста народів упали, і великий Вавилон був згаданий перед Богом, щоб дати йому чашу вина люті {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} гніву.
uk.B: Коли сьомий ангел вилив свою чашу в повітря, з храму, від престолу, пролунав могутній голос: «Сталося!» \v 18 Спалахнули блискавки, пролунали голоси і громи, і стався землетрус, такий страшний, що подібного не бувало, відколи люди живуть на землі. \v 19 Велике місто розкололося на три частини, і міста народів упали. Бог не забув великого Вавилона: {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав йому випити чашу вина свого лютого гніву.
uk.R: Сьомий ангел вилив свою чашу в повітря. З трону в храмі пролунав гучний голос. Він сказав: «Скінчено!» \v 18 Спалахнули блискавки, пролунали гучні звуки і загримів грім. І стався страшний землетрус, найсильніший, відколи на землі живуть люди. \v 19 Велике місто розкололося на три частини. Міста народів завалилися. І Бог згадав про велике місто Вавилон. Він дав йому випити чашу, наповнену вином {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} страшного гніву.

ja.L: そして、第七の[天使]が自分の鉢を空中に注いだ。すると、神殿の中から、玉座から、大きな声が出て来て言った。「事は成った。」\v 18 そして、稲妻と声と雷鳴が起こり、大きな地震が起こった。それは人間が地上に現れて以来、起こったことのないほどの地震であり、それほどに大きく激しい地震であった。\v 19 そして、大いなる都は三つに裂け、諸国の民の町々は倒れた。そして、大いなるバビロンは神の前で思い起こされ、神の怒りの憤りのぶどう酒の杯を与えられた。
ja.B: 第七の天使が自分の鉢を空中に注いだ。すると、神殿の中の玉座から大きな声が響いた。「事は成し遂げられた。」\v 18 稲妻が走り、とどろきと雷鳴が起こり、激しい地震が起こった。人間が地上に住むようになって以来、これほど大きな地震は一度も起こったことがなかった。\v 19 大いなる都は三つに引き裂かれ、諸国の民の町々は倒れた。神は大いなるバビロンを忘れることなく、ご自分の燃え上がる怒りのぶどう酒の杯を彼女に飲ませられた。
ja.R: 七番目の天使が、自分の鉢を空中に注ぎました。すると、神殿の中の玉座から大きな声がして、「すべて終わった」と言いました。\v 18 稲妻が光り、大きな音がとどろき、雷が鳴りました。そして、ひどい地震が起こりました。人間が地上に住むようになってから、これほどひどい地震は一度もありませんでした。\v 19 大きな都は三つに裂け、諸国の町々は崩れ落ちました。神は大きな都バビロンを思い出し、ご自分の激しい怒りのぶどう酒で満ちた杯を、バビロンに飲ませられました。

decisions.choice: It is done: the last plague completes God's wrath
decisions.reason: Γέγονεν is perfect: it has happened and stands done. The voice from the throne declares the end of the series (15:1). The same word sounds again in 21:6, at the making of all things new.

decisions.choice: an earthquake like none before: Daniel 12:1
decisions.reason: Daniel speaks of "a time of trouble such as never has been since there was a nation" (Daniel 12:1; compare Mark 13:19). The signs of God's presence (4:5; 8:5; 11:19) reach their height.
The great city is named in the same sentence: Babylon the great (compare 14:8; 17:18; 18:10). Its fall is told in chapters 17-18.

decisions.choice: remembered before God: God does not forget her sins
decisions.reason: To be remembered before God is to have one's deeds brought into judgment (18:5). The cup is the cup of 14:10; "the fury of his wrath" doubles the word for anger, as in 19:15.
The verb means to pour out; Balanced varies it with "emptied" to avoid repeating the same phrase seven times.

"Babeli" is the Swahili name of Babylon, as in 1 Peter 5:13. The city is a woman in these chapters, so Balanced and Readable say "alimnywesha" (made her drink); Swahili "-m-" covers her without a gendered pronoun.

The Greek perfect says that what was to happen has now happened (m1); Literal "imekwisha kuwa" keeps "it has come to be", Balanced the short cry "Imekwisha!" (it is done), Readable "everything is complete", as the English Readable says "It is finished".

decisions.choice: Hecho está (L); ¡Ya está hecho! (B); ¡Todo ha terminado! (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect says the thing is accomplished and stands so; Spanish says it in a short cry at each level.
The English has a gender span; Spanish "seres humanos" suits the phrase about humankind first living on the earth.
The last plague completes God's wrath (m1); "xong rồi" says it plainly in one breath, and Readable keeps it, where the English Readable says "It is finished".

The last plague completes God's wrath (meaning decision). "다 이루었다" would repeat the Korean wording of Jesus's word on the cross (John 19:30), which is a different Greek verb, so Korean says "이루어졌다", and Readable says "finished", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "ተደርጓል!" (it has been done, L); "ተፈጸመ!" (it is accomplished, B); "አበቃ!" (it is over, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek perfect says that what was to happen has now come about. "ሆኗል" alone sounds incomplete in Amharic, so Literal says "ተደርጓል"; Balanced uses the solemn "ተፈጸመ", and Readable the plain "አበቃ", as the English Readable says "It is finished".
"የሰው ልጅ" can mean humankind, but it is kept for the title Son of Man, so Balanced says "የሰው ዘር".

"बाबुल" is fixed for the whole book, as in Matthew 1:11-17, Acts 7:43 and 1 Peter 5:13, with feminine agreement, as in 14:8; "the great city" that is Babylon is "बड़ी नगरी" (the feminine word for a city), so that its agreement matches.
As in 14:10: the cup that is drunk is "प्याला" at Balanced and Readable, kept apart from the bowls.
"Свершилось" is the modern form of the cry; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: "事は成った" (L); "事は成し遂げられた" (B); "すべて終わった" (R)
decisions.reason: The perfect says that it has happened and stands done: the last plague completes God's wrath (m1).

decisions.choice: "怒りの憤り" (L); "燃え上がる怒り" (B); "激しい怒り" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek doubles its words for anger (m4). Literal keeps both words in the book's pairing ("憤り" fury, "怒り" wrath); Balanced and Readable make the doubling one strong phrase, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ πᾶσα νῆσος ἔφυγεν, καὶ ὄρη οὐχ εὑρέθησαν.

records.literal_gloss: And every island fled, and mountains not were found.

en.L: And every island fled, and mountains were not found.
en.B: Every island ran away, and the mountains were found no more.
en.R: Every island disappeared, and the mountains could not be found.

fr.L: Et toute île s’enfuit, et les montagnes ne furent pas retrouvées.
fr.B: Toutes les îles s’enfuirent, et l’on ne trouva plus de montagnes.
fr.R: Toutes les îles ont disparu, et on ne pouvait plus trouver les montagnes.

sw.L: Na kila kisiwa kikakimbia, na milima haikuonekana.
sw.B: Kila kisiwa kikakimbia, na milima haikuonekana tena.
sw.R: Kila kisiwa kikatoweka, na milima haikuweza kuonekana tena.

es.L: Y toda isla huyó, y no se hallaron montes.
es.B: Todas las islas huyeron, y los montes desaparecieron.
es.R: Todas las islas desaparecieron, y no se podían encontrar los montes.

vi.L: Và mọi hải đảo đều trốn mất, và không còn thấy các núi nữa.
vi.B: Mọi hải đảo đều chạy trốn, và các núi không còn tìm thấy đâu nữa.
vi.R: Mọi hải đảo đều biến mất, và không ai còn tìm thấy các núi nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 모든 섬이 도망하였고, 산들도 찾아볼 수 없었다.
ko.B: 모든 섬이 달아나 사라졌고, 산들도 더는 찾아볼 수 없었다.
ko.R: 모든 섬이 사라졌고, 산들도 찾을 수 없었다.

pt.L: E toda ilha fugiu, e montes não foram achados.
pt.B: Todas as ilhas fugiram, e os montes não foram mais encontrados.
pt.R: Todas as ilhas desapareceram, e não foi possível encontrar as montanhas.

am.B: ደሴቶች ሁሉ ሸሹ፤ ተራሮችም ከዚያ በኋላ አልተገኙም።
am.R: ደሴቶች ሁሉ ጠፉ፤ ተራሮችም ሊገኙ አልቻሉም።

hi.L: और हर एक द्वीप भाग गया, और पहाड़ न मिले।
hi.B: हर द्वीप भाग गया, और पहाड़ों का पता न रहा।
hi.R: हर द्वीप ग़ायब हो गया, और पहाड़ कहीं न मिले।

ru.L: И всякий остров убежал, и гор не нашлось.
ru.B: Все острова исчезли, и гор больше не стало.
ru.R: Все острова исчезли, и горы невозможно было найти.

uk.L: І кожен острів утік, і гір не знайшлося.
uk.B: Кожен острів утік, і гір більше не стало.
uk.R: Кожен острів зник, і гір не можна було знайти.

ja.L: そして、すべての島は逃げ去り、山々は見いだされなかった。
ja.B: すべての島は逃げ去り、山々は見えなくなった。
ja.R: すべての島は消え去り、山々はどこにも見当たらなくなりました。

decisions.choice: islands and mountains gone: the world's foundations shaken
decisions.reason: In 6:14 they were moved from their places; here they vanish (compare 20:11, where earth and sky flee from God's presence).

source.text: καὶ χάλαζα μεγάλη ὡς ταλαντιαία καταβαίνει ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀνθρώπους· καὶ ἐβλασφήμησαν οἱ ἄνθρωποι τὸν θεὸν ἐκ τῆς πληγῆς τῆς χαλάζης, ὅτι μεγάλη ἐστὶν ἡ πληγὴ αὐτῆς σφόδρα.

records.literal_gloss: And hail great as talent-weight comes down out of the heaven on the men, and blasphemed the men the God because of the plague of the hail, because great is the plague of it exceedingly.

en.L: And great hail, about a talent in weight, comes down from heaven on {{gender:people|men}}, and {{gender:people|men}} blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for its plague is exceedingly great.
en.B: Hailstones weighing about {{units:seventy-five pounds|a talent}} each came down out of the sky on {{gender:people|men}}, and they blasphemed God over the plague of hail, because the plague of it was very severe.
en.R: Huge hailstones fell from the sky on {{gender:people|men}}. Each one weighed about {{units:seventy-five pounds|a talent}}. People said evil things against God because the hail was so terrible.

fr.L: Et une grosse grêle, du poids d’un talent, descend du ciel sur les {{gender:humains|hommes}}, et les {{gender:humains|hommes}} blasphémèrent Dieu à cause du fléau de la grêle, car son fléau est extrêmement grand.
fr.B: Des grêlons pesant {{units:environ 35 kilos|un talent}} chacun tombèrent du ciel sur les {{gender:gens|hommes}}, et ils blasphémèrent Dieu à cause du fléau de la grêle, car ce fléau était terrible.
fr.R: D’énormes grêlons sont tombés du ciel sur les {{gender:gens|hommes}}. Chacun pesait {{units:environ 35 kilos|un talent}}. Les gens ont dit du mal de Dieu parce que la grêle était terrible.

sw.L: Na mvua ya mawe kubwa, [kila jiwe] kama talanta [kwa uzito], inashuka kutoka mbinguni juu ya watu, na watu wakamkufuru Mungu kwa sababu ya pigo la mvua ya mawe, kwa maana pigo lake ni kubwa mno.
sw.B: Mvua kubwa ya mawe, kila jiwe likiwa na uzito wa kama {{units:kilo 34|talanta moja}}, ikawashukia watu kutoka angani, nao wakamkufuru Mungu kwa sababu ya pigo hilo la mvua ya mawe, kwa kuwa pigo hilo lilikuwa kali mno.
sw.R: Mawe makubwa ya mvua yakaanguka kutoka angani juu ya watu. Kila jiwe lilikuwa na uzito wa kama {{units:kilo 34|talanta moja}}. Watu wakamtukana Mungu kwa sababu mvua hiyo ya mawe ilikuwa mbaya sana.

es.L: Y un gran granizo, como de un talento de peso, baja del cielo sobre {{gender:las personas|los hombres}}; y {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} blasfemaron contra Dios por la plaga del granizo, porque su plaga es sumamente grande.
es.B: Del cielo cayeron sobre {{gender:las personas|los hombres}} enormes granizos de {{units:unos 34 kilos|un talento}} cada uno, y ellos blasfemaron contra Dios por la plaga del granizo, porque era una plaga terrible.
es.R: Cayeron del cielo enormes granizos sobre {{gender:las personas|los hombres}}. Cada uno pesaba {{units:unos 34 kilos|un talento}}. La gente insultó a Dios porque el granizo era terrible.

vi.L: Và mưa đá lớn, mỗi viên nặng chừng một ta-lâng, từ trời rơi xuống trên loài người, và loài người phạm thượng đến Đức Chúa Trời vì tai họa mưa đá, vì tai họa ấy quá lớn.
vi.B: Những cục mưa đá, mỗi cục nặng chừng {{units:34 kg|một ta-lâng}}, từ trời rơi xuống trên loài người, và họ phạm thượng đến Đức Chúa Trời vì tai họa mưa đá, vì tai họa ấy thật khủng khiếp.
vi.R: Những cục mưa đá khổng lồ từ trời rơi xuống trên loài người. Mỗi cục nặng chừng {{units:34 kg|một ta-lâng}}. Người ta nói những lời xúc phạm Đức Chúa Trời vì mưa đá thật quá khủng khiếp.

ko.L: 그리고 한 달란트쯤 되는 큰 우박이 하늘에서 사람들 위에 떨어진다. 그리고 사람들은 우박의 재앙 때문에 하나님을 모독하였다. 그 재앙이 몹시 컸기 때문이다.
ko.B: 무게가 {{units:약 34킬로그램|한 달란트쯤}} 되는 큰 우박이 하늘에서 사람들 위에 떨어졌다. 사람들은 우박의 재앙 때문에 하나님을 모독했다. 그 재앙이 너무나 심했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 큰 우박이 하늘에서 사람들 위에 떨어졌다. 우박 하나의 무게가 {{units:약 34킬로그램|한 달란트쯤}} 되었다. 사람들은 우박이 너무 무서워서 하나님을 욕했다.

pt.L: E grande saraiva, como do peso de um talento, desce do céu sobre {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}}, e {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}} blasfemaram a Deus por causa da praga da saraiva, porque a sua praga é extremamente grande.
pt.B: Pedras de granizo de cerca de {{units:trinta e cinco quilos|um talento}} cada uma caíram do céu sobre {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}}, e blasfemaram a Deus por causa da praga do granizo, porque era uma praga terrível.
pt.R: Pedras enormes de granizo caíram do céu sobre {{gender:as pessoas|os homens}}. Cada uma pesava cerca de {{units:trinta e cinco quilos|um talento}}. As pessoas falaram mal de Deus porque o granizo era terrível demais.

am.L: መክሊት የሚያህልም ታላቅ በረዶ ከሰማይ በሰዎች ላይ ይወርዳል፤ ሰዎችም ከበረዶው መቅሠፍት የተነሣ እግዚአብሔርን ሰደቡ፤ መቅሠፍቱ እጅግ ታላቅ ነውና።
am.B: እያንዳንዱ {{units:34 ኪሎ ያህል|አንድ መክሊት}} የሚመዝን የበረዶ ድንጋይ ከሰማይ በሰዎች ላይ ወረደ፤ መቅሠፍቱም እጅግ ብርቱ ስለ ነበረ ከበረዶው መቅሠፍት የተነሣ እግዚአብሔርን ሰደቡ።
am.R: ትልልቅ የበረዶ ድንጋዮች ከሰማይ በሰዎች ላይ ወረዱ። እያንዳንዱ {{units:34 ኪሎ ያህል|አንድ መክሊት}} ይመዝን ነበር። በረዶው እጅግ አስከፊ ስለ ነበረ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን ሰደቡ።

hi.L: और आकाश से मनुष्यों पर एक-एक तालन्त भर के बड़े ओले गिरते हैं, और ओलों की विपत्ति के कारण मनुष्यों ने परमेश्वर की निन्दा की, क्योंकि उसकी विपत्ति बहुत ही बड़ी है।
hi.B: आकाश से मनुष्यों पर लगभग {{units:34 किलो|एक तालन्त}} भारी ओले गिरे, और ओलों की विपत्ति के कारण उन्होंने परमेश्वर की निन्दा की, क्योंकि वह विपत्ति बहुत ही भयंकर थी।
hi.R: आकाश से लोगों पर बहुत बड़े ओले गिरे। हर ओला लगभग {{units:34 किलो|एक तालन्त}} का था। लोगों ने परमेश्वर को बुरा-भला कहा, क्योंकि ओलों की विपत्ति बहुत भयानक थी।

ru.L: И большой град, весом с талант, сходит с неба на людей, и хулили люди Бога за язву града, потому что язва его весьма велика.
ru.B: С неба на людей падали градины весом {{units:около 35 килограммов|в талант}} каждая, и люди хулили Бога за казнь градом, потому что эта казнь была очень тяжёлой.
ru.R: С неба на людей падали огромные градины. Каждая весила {{units:около 35 килограммов|один талант}}. Люди говорили злые слова против Бога, потому что град был очень страшным.

uk.L: І великий град, вагою з талант, падає з неба на людей, і люди зневажали Бога за кару граду, бо кара від нього дуже велика.
uk.B: Градини вагою близько {{units:34 кілограмів|таланта}} кожна падали з неба на людей, і вони зневажали Бога за кару градом, бо ця кара була дуже тяжка.
uk.R: З неба на людей падали величезні градини. Кожна важила близько {{units:34 кілограмів|таланта}}. Люди говорили зле про Бога, бо град був такий страшний.

ja.L: そして、一タラントンほどの重さの大きな雹が、天から人々の上に降る。そして、人々は雹の災害のゆえに神を冒瀆した。その災害が非常に激しいからである。
ja.B: 重さが{{units:約35キログラム|一タラントン}}もある大きな雹が、天から人々の上に降った。人々は雹の災害のために神を冒瀆した。その災害があまりにも激しかったからである。
ja.R: 大きなひょうが、空から人々の上に降ってきました。一つの重さは{{units:約35キログラム|一タラントン}}もありました。人々は、このひょうの災害のために神をののしりました。それほどひどい災害だったのです。

decisions.choice: an echo of the plagues of Egypt: hail
decisions.reason: Like the trumpets, the bowls recall the plagues on Egypt (Exodus 9:22-26; compare Joshua 10:11). The bowls strike the whole of each realm, not a third: these are the last plagues (15:1).

decisions.choice: a talent: a very heavy weight
decisions.reason: A talent was the largest unit of weight, varying by region from about 55 to 100 pounds (25 to 45 kilograms). Hailstones of that size would crush whatever they struck.
As after the fourth and fifth bowls (16:9, 11), people blaspheme God instead of repenting.
Literal keeps the Greek measure; Balanced and Readable give a modern equivalent, with the original as the alternative (m2).

decisions.choice: {{units:environ 35 kilos|un talent}} (B, R); "du poids d’un talent" (L)
decisions.reason: French uses metric measures by default (style guide §7), where the English has US pounds; a talent weighed about 34 kilograms. Literal keeps the Greek measure.

As the Swahili style guide sets for units: metric by default (a talent weighed about 34 kilograms), with the original measure as the alternative, where the English default is seventy-five pounds. Literal keeps "talanta".
Spanish gives the metric equivalent of the English "seventy-five pounds", rounded; the original unit is the alternative, and Literal keeps it.
Literal keeps the Greek present tense, as elsewhere in the book.

decisions.choice: {{units:34 kg|một ta-lâng}} (B, R); the original weight at Literal
decisions.reason: The style guide sets metric by default for Vietnamese where the English converts to US units: a talent was a very heavy weight (m2), about 34 kg. "Ta-lâng" is the Vietnamese Matthew's form (25:15). Literal keeps the Greek measure.
Metric by default and the original unit as the alternative (Korean style guide, section 7), unlike the English pounds; a talent was about 34 kilograms. "되는" after the span fits both.
Metric by default in Portuguese (style section 7): the English "seventy-five pounds" is about thirty-five kilograms (m2). Literal keeps the Greek measure.

Amharic readers weigh in kilograms, so the metric figure is the default and the talent ("መክሊት") the alternative, as in French and Swahili; a talent was roughly 34 kilograms, though estimates vary. Literal keeps the Greek unit.
The Hindi units setting is metric by default, with the original measure as the alternative (style guide, section 7); Literal keeps the talent.
Russian gives the metric equivalent (a talent was about 34 kg), not the English pounds; Literal keeps the Greek measure.

decisions.choice: {{units:34 кілограмів|таланта}}: metric by default, the talent as the alternative; Literal keeps "талант"
decisions.reason: The shared Ukrainian terms take the talent as 34 kg; Ukrainian readers count in kilograms.

decisions.choice: "一タラントンほど" (L); {{units:約35キログラム|一タラントン}} (B, R)
alternatives: {{units:約30キログラム|一タラントン}}
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek measure. Balanced and Readable give a metric weight by default, as the Japanese style guide asks (the English gives pounds), with the talent as the alternative; the talent varied from about 25 to 45 kilograms (m2), and 35 kilograms matches the English seventy-five pounds. Literal also keeps the Greek present "降る" (see 14:3). Readable writes "ひょう" because "雹" is not a Jōyō kanji.
